title: Edible С4
description: Mod that lets you eat or feed C4 to your friends.
body:
## Edible С4

"Edible С4" is a simple and lightweight mod that lets you eat or feed explosives to your friends.

Place C4 charges anywhere and at anyone. Whether you're setting up ambushes, feeding them to your friends, or just causing a little controlled chaos, this mod provides a simple and fun way to use remote-controlled explosives in your world.

**Recommended for playing with the mod:** [Physics Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/physicsmod/versions)

Features
Placeable C4 explosive charges
Remote detonator for triggering explosions
Simple and intuitive gameplay


## How to use:
Craft a C4 charge.

![C4 Craft:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea0104ea804a78ff858c84f1c8c488e0c3f818fc.png)

Craft a detonator.

![Detonator craft:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f260e36d6f615070eb4f9c6510eb0189f093bc76.png)

Place it anywhere in the world, eat it or feed it to someone.
Use the remote detonator to trigger the explosion.
Enjoy the result.

Recome

### Compatibility
**Minecraft 1.21.1 - Fabric Loader**

If you encounter any issues or suggestions, please feel free to leave feedback.
